qe: What does 'Stagflation' mean?
qh: 'स्टैगफ्लेशन' (Stagflation) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Low inflation with high economic growth
High inflation with low economic growth and high unemployment
Recession only with falling price levels
Hyperinflation with rapid employment growth
e: Stagflation yaani stagnehshn aisi halat hai jismein mehngai bahut tez ho par aarthik vikas thama hua ho tatha beroonzmari bhi zyada ho, isliye ek hi samay do museebatein khadi rehti hain. Doosra vikalp is junk jodi ko theek dikhata hai. Yah sthiti isliye paida hoti hai ki maang tatha laagat dono ke dabaav ke beech karkhane utpadan nahi badha paate, isliye keemat chadhti jaati hai par kaam ke mauke nahi bante. Kam mehngai ke saath tez vikas, manda keval girti keematein tatha tez mehngai ke saath rozgar ka badhna - ye teen bayaan stagflation ke sahi matlab nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp alag halat bayaan karte hain. Exam point: mehngai badhe par vikas thame tatha beroonzmari bane - isi ko stagflation kehte hain.

qe: Which index is used by the RBI to measure headline inflation for monetary policy decisions in India?
qh: भारत में मौद्रिक नीति निर्धारण हेतु हेडलाइन मुद्रास्फीति मापने के लिए RBI किस सूचकांक का उपयोग करता है?
o: Wholesale Price Index (WPI)
Consumer Price Index - Combined (CPI-C)
Index of Industrial Production (IIP)
GDP Deflator
e: Bharat mein monetar neeti ke faisle ke liye mukhya mehngai ke pate ka naap CPI-C yaani Combined soochakank se liya jaata hai, isliye RBI isi ko dhyaan mein rakhkar bhaav ke faisle leta hai. Doosra vikalp isi soochakank ko chunta hai. Is chunav ka karan yah hai ki CPI-C poore desh ke gaon tatha sheher dono ke kharche ko jodta hai, isliye aam aadmi par padne wale bhaav ka sahi naksha milta hai. Thok soochakank, audyogik utpadan ka soochak tatha mooldhan soochakank mehngai ke in faislon ke sahi paimane nahi hain kyunki inmein upbhokta ka jhukav nahi dikhta. Yah teeno ankeda alag maqsad ke liye bandhte hain. Exam point: RBI ke bhaav ke faislon ka aadhar CPI-C hai tatha WPI nahi - yahi baat aksar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What does 'Inflation' fundamentally represent in an economy?
qh: अर्थव्यवस्था में 'मुद्रास्फीति' (Inflation) मूल रूप से क्या दर्शाती है?
o: A sustained rise in the general price level and a fall in purchasing power
A persistent fall in the general price level
A permanent freeze in the market prices of all goods
A complete cessation of the circulation of money
e: Inflation yaani mehngai ka asli matlab yah hai ki aam keematon ke star mein lagatar badhotri ho tatha rupaye ki khoonat taaqat girti rahe, isliye ek hi rupaye mein pehle se kam saaman milta hai. Pehla vikalp isi sahi matlab ko bayaan karta hai. Yah sthiti isliye banti hai ki samaan ke mukable paisa tatha maang tez badhte hain, isliye keematon ko chadhne ka dabaav bana rehta hai. Keematon ka lagatar girna, sab keematon ka hamesha ke liye jam jaana tatha paise ka poora chalan ruk jaana - ye teen bayaan mehngai ke nahi hain, balki ulti sthiti ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp mehngai ke sahi matlab se alag hain. Exam point: mehngai = keematon ke star mein lagatar badhotri tatha rupaye ki khoonat taaqat mein kami.

qe: What is meant by the economic concept of 'Tax Incidence'?
qh: अर्थशास्त्र में 'कर आपात' (Tax Incidence) का क्या तात्पर्य है?
o: The total annual tax revenue collected by the government
The illegal evasion of taxes by high-income earners
The final economic resting point or burden of a tax
The administrative cost incurred in collecting taxes
e: Tax Incidence yaani kar aapats ka matlab yah hai ki kisi kar ka asli bojh sadhan par aakhir mein kis par padta hai, chahe ushe kanoon kis par lagaya gaya ho. Teesra vikalp isi aakhri bojh ko sahi dikhata hai. Yah baat isliye dekhi jaati hai ki kar laagne wala tatha bojh uthane wala ek hi na ho; isliye utpadak aage badh chukka kar grahak ya vyapari par daal deta hai. Saalana kul kar vasooli, bade kamai walon dwara chori tatha vasooli ka kharcha - ye teen cheezein kar aapats ke sahi matlab nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp kar ke alag pehlu batate hain. Exam point: kar aapats batata hai ki bojh aakhir mein kis par padta hai - yeh laagne wale se alag ho sakta hai.

qe: What is the 'Tobin Tax' primarily designed to discourage in global finance?
qh: 'टोबिन टैक्स' (Tobin Tax) मुख्य रूप से किसे हतोत्साहित करने के लिए तैयार किया गया है?
o: Short-term speculative cross-border currency transactions
Domestic retail trading in gold and silver
Exports of manufactured agricultural products
Long-term foreign direct investments
e: Tobin Tax yaani Tobin kar mukhya roop se chhoti avadhi ke paisa badalne wale saudaon par lagta hai, jise satta si jaldi khareed-farokht se rokne ke liye banaya gaya tha. Pehla vikalp isi tarah ke saudaon ko chunta hai. Yah kar isliye sujhaya gaya ki thodi-se-thodi badhotri par paisa doosre deshon mein bhagta hai tatha deshon ki currency girne lagti hai, isliye ise thoda bhaari banane se jaldi ki bhag-daud rukti hai. Sone-chandi ka desi vyapar, kheti ke saaman ka niryat tatha lambe samay ka videshi nivesh - ye teen is kar ke laagat waale khaane nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp is kar ke maqsad se alag hain. Exam point: Tobin kar chhoti avadhi ke currency saudaon ko mehnga karta hai tatha lambe nivesh ko nahi rokta.

qe: What does the 'Matthew Effect' describe in the context of economic inequality?
qh: आर्थिक असमानता के संदर्भ में 'मैथ्यू प्रभाव' (Matthew Effect) क्या वर्णन करता है?
o: The complete elimination of socioeconomic barriers through taxation
The automatic and equal distribution of wealth across all income deciles
The rich tend to get richer while the poor get poorer due to cumulative advantage
The eradication of absolute poverty through industrial growth
e: Matthew Effect yaani Maths ka asar samajh mein yah bayaan karta hai ki jinke paas pehle se zyada hai unhe aage aur zyada milta hai tatha kam walon ki ghatti hui dekh gaye, isliye doori badhti jaati hai. Teesra vikalp isi badhti doori ko sahi likhta hai. Yah asar isliye dikhta hai ki paisa, achhi padhai tatha mauke apne aap un logon ke paas jate hain jinke paas pehle se sadhan hain, isliye chhoti shuruaat karne wale peeche chhoot jate hain. Kar ke zariye sab bandish ka khatm hona, sampatti ka barabar batwara tatha jaldi gareebi ka khatm hona - ye teen bayaan is asar ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp barabari ke daave se jude hain. Exam point: Matthew Effect = jinke paas hai unhe aur milta hai - yahi majmoot kaam avsar ka chakra hai.

qe: What is a 'Pigovian Tax' primarily designed to internalize?
qh: 'पिगोवियन टैक्स' (Pigovian Tax) मुख्य रूप से किसे आंतरिक बनाने के लिए लगाया जाता है?
o: International trade tariffs and duties
Subsidies on essential public goods
Negative externalities generated by market activities
Corporate net profit margins
e: Pigovian Tax yaani prithvi ke nukhsan ka kar un kharabon ke liye lagta hai jo dhanda apne kharch ya munafa mein nahi jodta, jaise pradu shan wala dhuan tatha kachre ka nukhsan. Teesra vikalp inhi kharabon ko andar laane ki baat karta hai. Yah kar isliye lagta hai ki jo keemat poora samaj chuk raha hai wo dhanda paid nahi karta, isliye ushe khud bharne par majboor karne se nukhsan kam hota hai. Aantrik vyapar ke shulk, upyogi saaman par sabsidi tatha kam ka munafa - ye teen cheezein is kar ke sahi laksh nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya niti ke zariye hain. Exam point: Pigovian kar bazaar ke bahari nukhsan yaani negative externality ko andar laata hai.

qe: What does the term 'Inflationary Gap' signify in macroeconomic theory?
qh: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में 'मुद्रास्फीति अंतराल' (Inflationary Gap) क्या दर्शाता है?
o: The excess of aggregate demand over aggregate supply at full employment
The gap between fiscal deficit and monetary base targets
A decline in consumer prices due to excess supply
The difference between the highest and lowest tax brackets
e: Inflationary Gap yaani mehngai ka antral yah batata hai ki jab saare sadhan pehle se lag chuke hon, us waqt kul maang kul utpadan se kitni zyada ho chukki hai, isliye keematein aage badh jaati hain. Pehla vikalp isi kheenchav ko theek pehchanta hai. Yah antral isliye banta hai ki desh ke saare sadhan pehle se lag chuke hote hain, isliye badhi hui rashi keval keematon ko chadhati hai tatha naya saaman nahi banati. Rajkoshi ghatt tatha monetar target ka antar, zyada aapurti se keematon ka girna tatha kar ki sabse oonchi tatha sabse nichli star ka phark - in teeno ka is antral ke dayre se koi taalluk nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp mehngai ke antral se alag hain. Exam point: poore rozgar par maang ka utpadan se zyada hona hi mehngai ka antral hai.

qe: What is 'Bracket Creep' in progressive taxation?
qh: प्रगतिशील कराधान में 'ब्रैकेट क्रीप' (Bracket Creep) क्या है?
o: A decrease in statutory tax rates during economic growth
Inflation pushing taxpayers into higher tax slabs without an increase in real income
The automatic indexing of tax exemptions to the consumer price index
A sudden decline in national tax compliance
e: Bracket Creep yaani briks ka khisakna prasidhi karadhan mein yah dekhta hai ki mehngai badhne se logon ki tankha badhti hai par kamai same rahti hai, isliye wo dheere-dheere oonche kar warg mein dhakel diye jate hain. Doosra vikalp isi khisakne ko sahi batata hai. Is dabaav ka karan yah hai ki kar ke warg tatha chhoot seedhe aankdon par bandhte hain, mehngai ke hisaab se nahi; isliye keval bhaav badhne se hi log kar ke dayre mein chale jate hain. Keematon ke saath kar ki dar kam hona, chhoot ka khud badalna tatha kar bharne ki reet ka girna - ye teen bayaan is khisakne ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp kar ke dhaanche se alag hain. Exam point: mehngai ke chakkar mein log keval aankdon ke hisaab se oonche warg mein pahunch jate hain - isi ka naam briks ka khisakna hai.

qe: What is an 'Inverted Duty Structure' in customs and indirect taxation?
qh: सीमा शुल्क और अप्रत्यक्ष कराधान में 'उल्टा शुल्क ढांचा' (Inverted Duty Structure) क्या है?
o: A tax structure that exempts intermediate goods while taxing local assembly
A tax structure where raw materials and inputs are taxed at a higher rate than finished goods
A uniform flat tariff applied to all imports and exports equally
A tax structure where all luxury goods are completely exempt from taxation
e: Inverted Duty Structure yaani ulta shulk dhaancha yah bidambana hai ki kachche maal tatha jude hisson par kar tayyar maal se zyada lagta hai, isliye desi karkhane ko mehngi laagat bhari padti hai. Doosra vikalp isi ulti seedhi ka sahi bayaan hai. Yah dhaancha isliye banta hai ki neeti alag-alag charan par alag dar tay karti hai; isliye tayyar maal par kam shulk hone se poora banane wala desi udyog paas ka maal saste mein bikar bhi ghate mein rehta hai. Jude hisson ki chhoot wala dhaancha, sab par ek jaisa shulk tatha shaunkh wale maal ki poori chhoot - ye teen bayaan is dhaanche ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp krash ke kar dhaanche se alag hain. Exam point: kachche maal par tayyar maal se zyada kar lagna = ulta shulk dhaancha.

qe: What relationship does the 'Laffer Curve' describe in public finance?
qh: 'लाफर वक्र' (Laffer Curve) सार्वजनिक वित्त में किस संबंध को दर्शाता है?
o: The relationship between sovereign debt and foreign exchange reserves
The inverse link between inflation and unemployment
The correlation between interest rates and private investment
The relationship between tax rates and total tax revenues collected
e: Laffer Curve yaani Laffer ka vakr sarvjaniya vitt mein yah rishta dikhata hai ki kar ki dar tatha kar se hone wali kul vasooli ke beech seedha sambandh nahi hota, balki ek hadd ke baad dar badhane se vasooli gir jaati hai. Chautha vikalp isi rishte ko sahi chunta hai. Yah badlav isliye dikhta hai ki bahut oonchi dar par log kaam hi chhod dete hain tatha chori badh jaati hai, isliye hukumat ke haath mein kam paisa aata hai. Rin tatha videshi bhandar ka rishta, mehngai tatha beroonzmari ka ulta jod tatha bhaav tatha niji nivesh ka sambandh - ye teen baatein is vakr ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya star ke rishte bayaan karte hain. Exam point: kar ki dar badhane par shuru mein vasooli badhti hai par ek hadd ke baad ghatne lagti hai - yahi Laffer ka vakr hai.

qe: How is 'Disinflation' defined in macroeconomics?
qh: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में 'डिसइन्फ्लेशन' (Disinflation) को कैसे परिभाषित किया जाता है?
o: An absolute decline in general price levels across the entire economy
A prolonged period of negative interest rates
A sharp acceleration of consumer price index numbers
A temporary slowdown in the rate of inflation while prices still rise
e: Disinflation yaani mehngai ki raftaar ka dheema hona: is dasha mein keematein badhti to rahti hain par pehle se kam raftaar se, isliye mahangi mein kami aati hai tatha birkul khatm nahi hoti. Chautha vikalp isi dheemi raftaar ko sahi bayaan karta hai. Yah sthiti isliye aati hai ki kendriya bank bhaav ke hasiyah se maang kam karta hai, isliye keematon ki badhotri ki raftaar girti hai par keematein gir nahi jaati. Aam keematon ka poori tarah girna, lambe samay ka rinaatmak beyaaj tatha soochakank ka tez chadhna - ye teen bayaan dheemi mehngai ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya halat ke bare mein hain. Exam point: mehngai ki raftaar girti hai par keematein badhti rehti hain - isi ko disinflation kehte hain.

qe: What is 'Galloping Inflation'?
qh: 'गैलपिंग मुद्रास्फीति' (Galloping Inflation) क्या है?
o: A drop in consumer prices triggered by agricultural overproduction
Rapid double- or triple-digit annual inflation ranging from 20% to several hundred percent
A situation where price growth is exactly zero over consecutive quarters
A mild, single-digit annual increase in prices of 2% to 3%
e: Galloping Inflation yaani sarrpati mehngai wo dasha hai jismein keematein saalana bees se aa sainkde pratishat tak badhti hain, isliye paisa tez girti taaqat wala banta jaata hai. Doosra vikalp isi tez raftaar ko sahi batata hai. Itni tez badhotri isliye hoti hai ki log paisa turant kharch kar dete hain tatha maang baghti rehti hai, isliye keematon ki seedhi tezi pakad leti hai. Kheti ke zyada utpadan se keematon ka girna, soonya ke aas-paas keematon ka tikna tatha do se teen pratishat ki maamooli badhotri - ye teen bayaan is tez mehngai ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp halki yaa girne wali mehngai se jude hain. Exam point: bees se sainkde pratishat tak ki saalana badhotri sarrpati mehngai kahi jaati hai.

qe: Which of the following levies is NOT subsumed under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कर भारत में वस्तु एवं सेवा कर (GST) के तहत शामिल नहीं किया गया है?
o: Service Tax
Central Excise Duty
State Value Added Tax (VAT)
Basic Customs Duty
e: Vastu tatha seva kar mein kai purane kar chhap gaye, par Basic Customs Duty yaani aayatan par lagne wala buniyadi shulk is dhaanche ke baahar rakha gaya kyunki yah seema ke paar vyapar se jude kar ke ghar ka hai. Chautha vikalp isi bahar rakhe gaye shulk ko chunta hai. Aisi chhoot isliye di gayi ki seema ke paar vyapar ke kar tatha baahar ke deshon par lagne wale shulk desh ki apni kheti ki alag taur par dekhe jaate hain, isliye unhe ismein nahi joda gaya. Seva kar, kendriya utpad shulk tatha rajya moolya vardhit kar waale kar is dhaanche mein sama liye gaye the, isliye wo ab alag nahi hain. Yah teeno purane kar nayi vyavastha mein mil gaye. Exam point: GST mein buniyadi seema shulk shaamil nahi hai - yahi sabse zyada poochha jaane wala apwaad hai.

qe: What characterizes a 'Deflationary Gap' in an economy?
qh: अर्थव्यवस्था में 'अपस्फीतिकारी अंतराल' (Deflationary Gap) की क्या विशेषता है?
o: An increase in production beyond maximum plant capacity
An uncontrolled surge in foreign exchange reserves
A shortfall of aggregate demand relative to full-employment output
An excess of consumer demand over potential output
e: Deflationary Gap yaani girti mehngai ka antral yah dikhata hai ki poore rozgar wale utpadan ke mukable desh ki maang kitni kam reh gayi hai, isliye karkhane band hote hain tatha kaam ke mauke girte hain. Teesra vikalp isi kami ko sahi bayaan karta hai. Yah kami isliye khatarnak hai ki kam maang ke kaale mein maal na bike to keemat tatha utpadan dono girte hain, isliye beroonzmari phailti jaati hai. Kshetra se zyada utpadan, videshi bhandar ka bekaabu badhna tatha maang ka ratbhar se oopar hona - ye teen bayaan is antral ke nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp badhi hui maang ki kahani hain. Exam point: poora rozgar hone par bhi maang ka kam reh jaana girti mehngai ka antral hai.

qe: What does 'Headline Inflation' measure?
qh: 'हेडलाइन मुद्रास्फीति' (Headline Inflation) क्या मापती है?
o: Total broad-based inflation including volatile food and energy components
Inflation calculated exclusively for manufactured industrial goods
Price changes restricted strictly to services
Inflation calculated solely for urban commercial real estate
e: Headline Inflation yaani mukhya mehngai poore bazaar tokri par nazar rakhti hai, jismein khaane-peene ke saaman tatha indhan jaise tez ghumne wale hisse bhi shaamil hote hain, isliye yah aam aadmi ka saara bojh dikhati hai. Pehla vikalp isi poore dayre ko sahi dikhata hai. Yah naap isliye zaroori hai ki isse pata chalta hai ki bazaar mein asli keematein kis raftaar se badh rahi hain, bina kisi hisse ko hataaye. Keval bane hue audyogik maal ki mehngai, keval sevaon ke bhaav tatha keval shehri zameen ke bhaav - ye teen bayaan is naap ke sahi dayre nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp tokri ke chhote hisson se jude hain. Exam point: mukhya mehngai khaane-peene tatha indhan samet poori tokri naapti hai - ismein koi hissa nahi hataya jaata.

qe: What is a 'Tariff' in the context of international trade?
qh: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार के संदर्भ में 'टैरिफ' (Tariff) क्या है?
o: An insurance fee against exchange rate depreciation
A subsidy granted to exporters to boost overseas sales
A tax or customs duty levied on imported goods entering a country
A licensing fee applied to oceanic shipping vessels
e: Tariff yaani seema shulk wo kar ya seema shulk hai jo doosre deshon se aane wale saaman par lagaya jaata hai, isliye baahar ka maal desh mein pahunchne par mehnga ho jaata hai. Teesra vikalp isi shulk ko sahi pehchanta hai. Yah kar isliye lagaya jaata hai ki desi udyog ko baahar ke saste maal se bachaya ja sake tatha sarkar ko aay mile, isliye ise aayatan par lagne wala shulk bhi kaha jaata hai. Bhaav girne se bacha ka bima, niryat ko badhane wali sabsidi tatha jahaajon ka licence shulk - ye teen cheezein seema shulk ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp vyapar ke alag lena-den se jude hain. Exam point: aayatan par lagne wala kar hi tariff hai - yahi desi bazaar ko baahar ke maal se bachata hai.

qe: What relationship is depicted by the traditional 'Phillips Curve'?
qh: पारंपरिक 'फिलिप्स वक्र' (Phillips Curve) किसके बीच के संबंध को दर्शाता है?
o: Interest rate variations against sovereign bond yields
Direct correlation between tax revenues and fiscal deficits
Economic output and income distribution
An inverse relationship between inflation and unemployment
e: Phillips Curve yaani Phillips ka vakr parasparik roop se mehngai tatha beroonzmari ke beech ulta rishta dikhata hai, isliye jab mehngai badhti hai to beroonzmari girti dikhti hai tatha ulta bhi hota hai. Chautha vikalp isi ulti dekh ko sahi batata hai. Yah rishta isliye bana ki badhi hui maang ko pura karne ke liye kaam ke mauke badhte hain, isliye keematon ke bhaav tatha rozgar mein ulte badlav dikhte hain. Bhaav tatha videshi bond ke bhaav ka jod, kar tatha rajkoshi ghatt ka seedha jod tatha utpadan tatha aay baantwara - in teeno bayanon ka is curve se mel nahi baithta. Yah teeno vikalp anya aarthik rishton se jude hain. Exam point: mehngai tatha beroonzmari ke beech ulta rishta hi Phillips ka vakr hai.

qe: Which consumer segments are tracked by the 'CPI-Combined' index published by NSO?
qh: NSO द्वारा प्रकाशित 'CPI-Combined' सूचकांक द्वारा किन उपभोक्ता वर्गों को ट्रैक किया जाता है?
o: Both rural and urban households nationwide
Wholesale traders and bulk manufacturers only
Urban organized-sector workers exclusively
Rural consumers exclusively
e: Bharat mein NSO yaani saankhyiki karyalaya jo CPI-Combined nikaalta hai, uske do hisse hain - ek gaon ke upbhokta tatha doosra shehri ghar ke upbhokta, isliye yah soochakank desh ke dono taraf ke parivaron par nazar rakhta hai. Pehla vikalp inhi dono varon ko sahi batata hai. Dono taraf ko jodne ka karan yah hai ki gaon tatha sheher ke kharche tatha samaan alag hote hain; isliye ek hi soochakank se desh bhar ki mehngai ka poora tasveer milta hai. Thok vyapari tatha karkhane, keval shehri sangathit shramik tatha keval gaon ke log - ye teen varg is soochakank ke sahi dayre nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp kisi ek varg tak seemit hain. Exam point: CPI-Combined gaon tatha sheher dono ke upbhokta ghar ko ek saath ginta hai.

qe: How is an 'Ad Valorem Tax' levied on commodities or transactions?
qh: 'एड वैलोरम कर' (Ad Valorem Tax) वस्तुओं या लेन-देन पर किस आधार पर लगाया जाता है?
o: Based on the physical distance over which goods are transported
As a fixed percentage of the monetary value of the good or transaction
According to the number of manufacturing stages involved
As a fixed monetary fee per unit of physical weight or volume
e: Ad Valorem Tax yaani molya ke anupat lagne wala kar saaman ya lena-den ki keemat ke ek theek pratishat ke roop mein lagaya jaata hai, isliye keemat badhne par kar ki rashi bhi badh jaati hai. Doosra vikalp isi pratishat wale aadhar ko sahi batata hai. Yah tarika isliye chuna jaata hai ki mehngi cheez par zyada tatha sasti cheez par kam kar apne aap ban jaata hai, isliye keemat ke saath kar ka bhaar baithta rehta hai. Dhoom ki doori ke hisaab se lagne wala kar, banana ke charan ginne wala tarika tatha bhaar ya aayatan par tay rashi - ye teen bayaan is kar ke sahi aadhar nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp tay rashi wale kar se jude hain. Exam point: keemat ke pratishat ke roop mein lagne wala kar hi molya anupati kar hai.

qe: Which index is historically published by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry to measure wholesale price changes in India?
qh: भारत में थोक स्तर पर मूल्य परिवर्तनों को मापने के लिए वाणिज्य और उद्योग मंत्रालय द्वारा कौन सा सूचकांक जारी किया जाता है?
o: Index of Industrial Production (IIP)
National Real Estate Index (RESIDEX)
Wholesale Price Index (WPI)
Consumer Price Index (CPI)
e: Bharat mein thok bazaar ke keemat badlav ka akella aankda vaanijy tatha udyog mantralaya theek karta hai, isliye WPI ki aankde wahin se nikalti hain. Teesra vikalp isi soochakank ko chunta hai. Yah soochakank isliye pehle aata hai ki pehle thok bhaav badalta hai, phir wahi badlav dhul-bhar mein khudra bazaar tak pahunchta hai, isliye yah aage ki mehngai ka sanket deta hai. Audyogik utpadan ka soochak, shehri zameen ka soochak tatha khudra upbhokta ka soochak - ye teen cheezein thok keemat ke sahi paimane nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya starpar bandhte hain. Exam point: WPI ko vaanijy tatha udyog mantralaya nikaalta hai - yahi thok keemat ka purana soochakank hai.

qe: On what economic base is 'Corporate Income Tax' assessed?
qh: 'कॉर्पोरेट आयकर' (Corporate Tax) किस आर्थिक आधार पर लगाया जाता है?
o: Net taxable profit earned by registered domestic and foreign corporations
Gross sales turnover without deducting business expenses
Total payroll expenditure incurred on staff
Total capital assets held on the balance sheet
e: Corporate Tax yaani kameti par lagne wala kar sirf kameti ke asli kamai par lagta hai, yaani bika ke baad kharch tatha deya sab ghatane ke baad jo kar yogya munafa bachta hai usi par lagta hai. Pehla vikalp isi saaf munafe ko chunta hai. Yah aadhar isliye tay hua ki jiska munafa ho wahi kar de, isliye bikri tatha kharch dono ke aankde hisaab kitaab se jode jaate hain tatha bacha hua labh hi kar le jata hai. Kharche ghataye bina khuli bikri, karmchariyon par kul kharch tatha balance sheet mein kul punji - ye teen cheezein kar ke sahi aadhar nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp munafe ke bina lagne wale aadhar hain. Exam point: kameti kar net taxable profit par lagta hai - bina kharch ghataye niklne wali bikri par nahi.

qe: How is 'Core Inflation' derived from headline inflation figures?
qh: हेडलाइन मुद्रास्फीति से 'कोर मुद्रास्फीति' (Core Inflation) कैसे प्राप्त की जाती है?
o: By adjusting price growth against the fiscal deficit
By tracking only raw material prices
By removing services from the price basket
By excluding volatile food and fuel/energy groups from the overall CPI index
e: Core Inflation yaani kendriya mehngai mukhya mehngai se tez ghumne wale hisse - jaise khaane-peene tatha indhan-energy - hataakar nikaali jaati hai, isliye yah keematon ki asli tatha tike rahne wali chalti dikhati hai. Chautha vikalp isi tarike ko sahi bayaan karta hai. Aise hisson ko hatane ka karan yah hai ki mausam tatha vishwa bazaar se inke bhaav jhatke khate hain, isliye inhe jodne se asli chalan dhundhla ho jaata hai. Rajkoshi ghatt se tulna karna, keval kachche maal ko ginte rehna tatha sevaon ko tokri se hata dena - ye teen bayaan is naap ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp kendriya mehngai ki reet se alag hain. Exam point: khaane-peene tatha indhan-energy nikaalne ke baad jo mehngai bachti hai wahi kendriya mehngai hai.

qe: What does the acronym 'GST' officially stand for in Indian tax administration?
qh: भारतीय कर प्रणाली में संक्षिप्त नाम 'GST' का आधिकारिक पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
o: Goods and Services Tax
Global Shipping Tariff
Government Statutory Tariff
General Sales Tax
e: GST yaani goods and services tax ka poora naam tatha matlab yah hai ki yah saaman tatha sevaon ki aapurti ke har charan par ek hi raashtra vyapii shulk lagata hai, isliye poore desh mein ek hi kar ki tarah chalta hai. Pehla vikalp isi poore naam ko sahi likhta hai. Ek hi vyapii kar ka raasta isliye chuna gaya ki pehle rajya-dar-rajya alag kar ched-tod paida karte the, isliye ek jatil vyavastha se poore desh mein ek bazaar ban gaya. Vishwa bhandar shulk, sarkari vidhan shulk tatha aam bikri kar - ye teen naam isi kaamon ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya naam ke khandan hain. Exam point: GST ka poora naam goods and services tax hai - yahi bharat ki sabse badi apratyaksh kar sudhaar hai.

qe: What is a 'Tariff War' between trading nations?
qh: व्यापारिक राष्ट्रों के बीच 'टैरिफ वॉर' (Tariff War) क्या है?
o: An agreement to dismantle all import and export duties mutually
The complete conversion to a common currency
Military conflict over shipping channels
A retaliatory cycle where countries repeatedly raise import duties on each other's goods
e: Tariff War yaani shulk jung aisi halat hai jismein ek desh aayatan par kar badhata hai to doosra bhi badlav ke saath jawab deta hai, isliye dono taraf ke kar aage-peeche badhte rehte hain. Chautha vikalp isi badle ki ladi ko sahi batata hai. Yah ladi isliye shuru hoti hai ki har desh apne udyog tatha rozgar bachana chahta hai, isliye ek ke shulk badhne par doosre ko bhi apni rakha ki raksha karni padti hai. Sab shulk mitane ka samjhauta, ek hi currency apnana tatha vyapar ke raston par sena ka takraav - ye teen bayaan is shabd ke sahi matlab nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya ghatnaon ki taraf ishara karte hain. Exam point: ek desh ke shulk ke jawab mein doosre desh ka shulk - isi jawab-wale chakkar ko shulk jung kehte hain.

qe: What is a 'Lump-Sum Tax' in fiscal economics?
qh: राजकोषीय अर्थशास्त्र में 'एकमुश्त कर' (Lump-Sum Tax) क्या है?
o: A tax applied exclusively to imported gold bars
A tax calculated as a dynamic percentage of consumer expenditure
A fixed-amount tax that remains constant regardless of the taxpayer's income or actions
An optional contribution to local public libraries
e: Lump-Sum Tax yaani ek hi rashi wala kar ek tay rakam hota hai jo vyakti ki kamai ya kaam se nahi badalta, isliye yah apni jagah jam kar rehta hai. Teesra vikalp isi jamav wale rakam ko sahi dikhata hai. Aisa kar isliye lagaya jaata hai ki vyakti ke kaam tatha kamai ko chhune bina sarkar ko ek nishchit aay mile, isliye isse kar ke asar ka alag adhyayan aasan hota hai. Aayatan ke sone ke chhade par lagne wala kar, kharch ke pratishat ke roop mein badalta kar tatha muhalle ki kitaabon ka apne mann se diya chanda - ye teen cheezein is kar ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp badalte ya chhoti-jagah ke kar se jude hain. Exam point: vyakti ki kamai se na badalne wala tay rakam hi ek hi rashi wala kar hai.

qe: Which of the following is categorized as a 'Direct Tax' in India?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किसे भारत में 'प्रत्यक्ष कर' (Direct Tax) के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
o: Goods and Services Tax
State Excise Duty
Personal Income Tax
Central Customs Tariff
e: Pratyaksh kar yaani direct tax wo hai jiska bojh bhugtane wale se aage nahi sarakta, isliye Personal Income Tax yaani vyakti ki aay par lagne wala kar isi jaati mein ginta hai. Teesra vikalp isi pratyaksh kar ko chunta hai. Is jati ka karan yah hai ki aay tatha sampatti par lagne wale kar sadhan se nahi sarakte, isliye unhe dekhkar pata chalta hai ki bojh kiske kandhon par hai. GST, rajya ka abhkari shulk tatha seema shulk aage badhne wale kar hain kyunki ye saaman tatha bikri se jude hain. Yah teeno apratyaksh kar ke udaharan hain. Exam point: aay tatha sampatti par lagne wale kar pratyaksh hote hain tatha saaman ki bikri ke kar apratyaksh.

qe: What triggers a 'Demand-Pull Inflation' in an economy?
qh: अर्थव्यवस्था में 'मांग-जनित मुद्रास्फीति' (Demand-Pull Inflation) का क्या कारण होता है?
o: An oversupply of manufactured inventory in warehouses
A sharp deflation in consumer credit volumes
An unexpected spike in raw material supply costs
Aggregate demand growing significantly faster than aggregate productive capacity
e: Demand-Pull Inflation yaani maang se khinchi mehngai tab paida hoti hai jab kul maang kul utpadan ki shakti se kaafi tez badh jaati hai, isliye khareedar kheenchta hai tatha keemat chadh jaati hai. Chautha vikalp isi tez maang ko sahi thehrata hai. Yah kheenchav isliye paida hota hai ki logon ke haath mein paisa badh jaata hai par saaman utna hi banta hai, isliye khapat ki daud keematon ko oopar dhakel deti hai. Godam mein saaman ka bekaabu jama hona, upbhokta karz ka girna tatha kachche maal ki laagat ka achanak chadhna - ye teen bayaan is mehngai ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp laagat wali mehngai se jude hain. Exam point: kul maang ka utpadan se tez badhna hi maang se khinchi mehngai hai.

qe: On what economic gain is 'Capital Gains Tax' levied in India?
qh: भारत में 'पूंजीगत लाभ कर' (Capital Gains Tax) किस प्रकार के लाभ पर लगाया जाता है?
o: Profits realized from the transfer or sale of capital assets like real estate, equities, and bonds
Cash gifts received from immediate family members
Interest earned on basic savings bank accounts
Monthly contractual employment salaries
e: Capital Gains Tax yaani punjigeey labh par lagne wala kar sirf tab lagta hai jab zameen, hisse tatha bond jaisi punji ki cheez bikri ya badle se labh hota hai, isliye keval kamai ke waqt hi yah kar banta hai. Pehla vikalp isi bikri wale labh ko sahi batata hai. Is tarah ke aadhar ka karan yah hai ki bikri se pehle kamai keval kitaab mein hoti hai, isliye vasooli tab hi hoti hai jab cheez haath se nikal kar paisa aata hai. Ghar walon se mile tohfe, bachat khate par mila beyaaj tatha mahine ki tankha - ye teen cheezein is kar ke sahi kamaiyan nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya aay ke srot hain. Exam point: punji ki cheez ki bikri se mile labh par hi punjigeey labh kar lagta hai.

qe: What does the metric 'Tax Buoyancy' measure?
qh: 'टैक्स बॉयन्सी' (Tax Buoyancy) क्या मापती है?
o: The volume of sovereign debt issued through green bonds
The percentage of annual tax returns filed after due dates
The volatility of international customs duties
The responsiveness of tax revenue growth to changes in national GDP without adjustments for rate changes
e: Tax Buoyancy yaani kar ki prachalanta yah naapti hai ki desh ki kamai badhne par kar vasooli kitni tez badhti hai, bina kar ki dar tatha chhoot badle hue. Chautha vikalp isi chetna ko sahi bayaan karta hai. Yah naap isliye dekhi jaati hai ki badhotri ke baad bina dar badhaye vasooli khud badhe to kar ka dhaancha majboor dikhta hai, isliye neeti banane walon ko iska pata rehna chahiye. Hari prakar ke bond ki bikri, der se bharne wale tohfe ki ginti tatha seema shulk ka utar-chadhav - ye teen cheezein is naap ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp kar ke dhaanche se alag pehlu hain. Exam point: kamai badhne par bina dar badhaye vasooli ka badhna hi kar ki prachalanta hai.

qe: Which specialized consumer price index is compiled by the Labour Bureau specifically for rural manual laborers?
qh: श्रम ब्यूरो द्वारा विशेष रूप से ग्रामीण श्रमिकों के लिए कौन सा मूल्य सूचकांक तैयार किया जाता है?
o: CPI for Agricultural Labourers (CPI-AL)
CPI for Industrial Workers (CPI-IW)
Urban Non-Manual Employees Index (CPI-UNME)
Services Purchasing Managers' Index
e: Gaon ke mazdooron ki mehngai naapne ke liye shram byuro CPI-AL yaani kheti mazdoor soochakank tez karta hai, isliye kheti wale mazdooron ke kharche ka alag hisaab rehta hai. Pehla vikalp isi soochakank ko sahi chunta hai. Is alag soochakank ka karan yah hai ki kheti ke mazdoor ke kharche tatha karkhane ke mazdoor ke kharche alag hote hain, isliye dono ki mehngai alag naapi jaati hai. Audyogik mazdooron ka soochakank, shehri daftar karmiyon ka soochakank tatha sevaon ka khareedar soochakank - ye teen anya vargon ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp alag karmchari samuh se jude hain. Exam point: gaon ke kheti mazdooron ke liye CPI-AL hi soochakank hai tatha karkhane ke mazdooron ke liye CPI-IW.

qe: What is the primary rationale for imposing a 'Countervailing Duty' (CVD) on imports?
qh: आयात पर 'काउंटरवेलिंग ड्यूटी' (CVD) लगाने का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To neutralize the unfair price advantage created by foreign government subsidies on imported goods
To lower the domestic market price of essential foodstuffs
To completely ban foreign luxury imports
To generate foreign currency reserves for sovereign wealth funds
e: Countervailing Duty yaani CVD tatha tulna shulk videshi sarkar dwara di gayi sabsidi ka asar mitane ke liye lagaya jaata hai, isliye baahar ke saste maal ka nakli fayda thik karke desi udyog ko barabar maidan deta hai. Pehla vikalp isi barabari wale maqsad ko sahi batata hai. Yah shulk isliye lagta hai ki videshi sarkar apne niryatak ko sasti rakam de to baahar ka maal asli keemat se kam par bikta hai, isliye us chhut ka lalach mitane ke liye yah kar lagta hai. Khaane ke saaman ka daam ghatana, shaunkh wale aayatan par poori rok tatha sarkari bhandar ke liye videshi paisa jodna - ye teen bayaan is shulk ke sahi maqsad nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya vyaparik kadam hain. Exam point: videshi sabsidi ka asar mitane ke liye lagne wala shulk hi tulna shulk hai.

qe: Under which Constitutional Article was the GST Council established in India?
qh: भारत में किस संवैधानिक अनुच्छेद के तहत GST परिषद का गठन किया गया था?
o: Article 280
Article 268A
Article 279A
Article 246A
e: GST Council yaani kar parishad ka gathan samvidhan ke Article 279A ke tehat ek notis ke zariye kiya gaya, isliye yah niyam ke saath banaya gaya vishesh sadhan hai. Teesra vikalp isi anuchhed ko sahi batata hai. Alag anuchhed ki zarurat isliye padi ki kendriya tatha rajya dono sarkar milkar ek hi kar ki dar tay karein, isliye samvidhan mein hi is parishad ki jagah bana di gayi. Article 280 vitt ayog ke liye hai, Article 268A purane seva kar ke liye tha tatha Article 246A kar lagane ke haq se juda hai. Yah teeno anuchhed alag vishay batate hain. Exam point: GST Council ka gathan Article 279A ke tehat hua - ismein kendra tatha rajya dono saath hain.

qe: What is 'Creeping Inflation' in economic classification?
qh: आर्थिक वर्गीकरण में 'रेंगती मुद्रास्फीति' (Creeping Inflation) क्या है?
o: A negative annual inflation rate below 0%
Price volatility limited strictly to energy products
A sudden quarterly jump in prices exceeding 50%
A slow, mild, and predictable annual price rise of around 2% to 3%
e: Creeping Inflation yaani rengti mehngai wo halki badhotri hai jo saal bhar do se teen pratishat ke aas-paas rehti hai tatha pehle se andaaza lagaya ja sakta hai, isliye yah mehngai ka sabse narm roop hai. Chautha vikalp isi narm tatha dheemi raftaar ko sahi likhta hai. Is roop ko theek mana jaata hai kyunki yah dhanda tatha khapat ko chaukne nahi deti, isliye sarkar tatha bazaar dono ko iske saath chalne ka samay mil jaata hai. Shunya se neeche ki mehngai, keval indhan tak seemit utar-chadhav tatha pachas pratishat se zyada ka ek jhatka - ye teen bayaan is narm roop ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp tez ya rinaatmak badlav se jude hain. Exam point: saalana do se teen pratishat ki dheemi badhotri hi rengti mehngai hai.

qe: What is the purpose of the 'Minimum Alternate Tax' (MAT) under the Income Tax Act?
qh: आयकर अधिनियम के तहत 'न्यूनतम वैकल्पिक कर' (MAT) का क्या उद्देश्य है?
o: To tax unincorporated micro-enterprises in rural areas
To impose an environmental surcharge on manufacturing units
To tax foreign portfolio dividends exclusively
To ensure that highly profitable companies utilizing tax exemptions pay a minimum floor tax on book profits
e: MAT yaani nyoonatam vaikal pik kar ka maksad yah hai ki jin kametiyon ko chhoot tatha riyayat se kharch hote hain, unhe bhi kitaabi munafe par ek kam se kam kar dena pade - isliye poori chhoot khatm ho jaati hai. Chautha vikalp isi kam se kam rakam wale bhaav ko sahi batata hai. Yah dayra isliye bandha gaya ki bahut fayde wali kameti shunye ke aas-paas kar bhar deti thi, isliye kitaabi kamai par bhi ek tay hadd tak kar thopna zaroori ho gaya. Gaon ke chhote dhanda, bane hue maal par paryavaran upkar tatha videshi hisson ke labhansh - ye teen cheezein is ke shadd ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya kaamon se jude kar hain. Exam point: kitabi munafe par kam se kam kar dena hi nyoonatam vaikal pik kar ka maqsad hai.

qe: What is the controversial 'Angel Tax' (Section 56(2)(viib)) in the Indian startup ecosystem?
qh: भारतीय स्टार्टअप पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र में 'एंजेल टैक्स' क्या है?
o: A flat registration tariff on venture capital funds
Tax on share capital raised by unlisted startups that exceeds the fair market value of the shares
A tax applied to humanitarian charitable trusts
An exemption granted to foreign investors in stock markets
e: Angel Tax yaani shuruaati nivesh par lagne wala kar un gair-rajistrit companyon ki bhagidari se badhe hue punji par lagta hai, jahan mila paisa hisson ki asli keemat se zyada ho, isliye shuruaati daur ke nivesh par asar padta hai. Doosra vikalp isi zyada keemat wale farak ko sahi bayaan karta hai. Yah kar isliye charcha mein aata hai ki nayi company ke hisse ki keemat tay karna mushkil hota hai, isliye mili rashi tatha kitaabi keemat ke beech ke farak ko kamai maan liya jaata tha. Vitt punji nidhiyon ki tay rakam, insani madad wale nyas par kar tatha videshi niveshakon ki chhoot - ye teen baatein is kar ke dayre se bahar ki hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya kar tatha chhoot se jude hain. Exam point: gair-rajistrit shuruaati company ke hisson ki keemat se zyada punji par lagne wala kar hi angel tax kehlata hai.

qe: What is the primary role of the 'General Anti-Avoidance Rules' (GAAR) introduced in Indian taxation?
qh: भारतीय कराधान में लागू 'जनरल एंटी-अवॉयडेंस रूल्स' (GAAR) की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या है?
o: To empower revenue authorities to invalidate aggressive and artificial business structures set up solely for tax avoidance
To abolish double taxation treaties with offshore financial hubs
To audit the asset declarations of constitutional officeholders
To collect local municipal property taxes
e: GAAR yaani aam kar bachav rodh niyam revenue adhikariyon ko yah haq dete hain ki ve keval kar bachane ke liye banaye gaye nakli dhaanche tatha saudaon ko radd kar sakein. Pehla vikalp isi shakti ko sahi dikhata hai. Yeh niyam isliye laaye gaye ki kametiyan sujhe hue jale raaste se kar bachati thi, isliye kanoon ke sirf lafzi sach ko nahi, asli maksad ko dekhne ki zarurat padi. Dohre kar samjhauton ko khatm karna, sanvidhan pada wale logon ki sampatti jaanchna tatha muhalle ke sampatti kar vasoolna - ye teen kaam is niyam ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya vibhagon ke kaam hain. Exam point: nakli jale raaste se kar bachane ko rokna hi GAAR ka asli kaam hai.

qe: What causes 'Cost-Push Inflation' in macroeconomics?
qh: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में 'लागत-जनित मुद्रास्फीति' (Cost-Push Inflation) का क्या कारण होता है?
o: An unexpected decline in sovereign debt yields
A rise in input costs, wages, or imported commodities that shifts the aggregate supply curve backward
Rapid expansion of broad money supply by the central bank
A surge in residential property speculation
e: Cost-Push Inflation yaani laagat se badhi mehngai tab hoti hai jab kachche maal, mazdoori ya aayatan ki cheezon ke daam chadh jaate hain, isliye aapurti ka vakr peeche khisak jaata hai. Doosra vikalp isi laagat ke chadhne ko sahi thehrata hai. Yah dabaav isliye banta hai ki banana wale ko mehnga kachcha maal tatha mehngi mazdoori bhari padti hai, isliye wo kam bana kar zyada keemat maangta hai. Rin par beyaaj ka girna, kendra ki taraf se paise ka bekaabu chhapna tatha zameen ka satta karna - in teeno ka is mehngai ke dabaav se koi taalluk nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp maang wali mehngai tatha paise ki chhapai se jude hain. Exam point: laagat badhne se aapurti peeche hat jaaye to us mehngai ko laagat se badhi mehngai kehte hain.

qe: What is the economic concept of the 'Inflation Tax'?
qh: अर्थशास्त्र में 'मुद्रास्फीति कर' (Inflation Tax) की क्या अवधारणा है?
o: A luxury tax imposed on high-end automobiles during inflation
The invisible loss of purchasing power suffered by cash holders when currency is diluted by monetary expansion
A specific cess levied on retail fuel stations
An excise levy on processed consumer foodstuffs
e: Inflation Tax yaani mehngai roop kar koi dikhta hua kar nahi hai, balki yah paise rakhne walon ki khoonat taaqat ka woh chhupa ghata hai jo chhap rahi currency ke kaaran mein khud-ba-khud ho jaata hai. Doosra vikalp isi chhup hi ghati ko sahi bayaan karta hai. Yah keemat isliye badhti hai ki paise ki matra badhne se har rupaye ki asli keemat ghat jaati hai, isliye jeb mein rakha paisa apni taqat kho deta hai. Mehngi gaadi par lagne wala shaunkh kar, pitrol pampon par lagne wala upkar tatha khane-peene ke saaman par lagne wala abhkari shulk - ye teen vikalp dikhte hue kar hain. Yah teeno vikalp sarkar dwara lagne wale saaf kar hain. Exam point: paise ki hichki se cash rakhne walon ki khoonat taaqat ka girna hi mehngai roop kar hai.

qe: What is the 'Securities Transaction Tax' (STT) in Indian financial markets?
qh: भारतीय वित्तीय बाजारों में 'प्रतिभूति लेनदेन कर' (STT) क्या है?
o: An annual license fee for registered retail stockbrokers
A direct turnover tax levied on the value of securities bought or sold on recognized stock exchanges
A stamp duty on corporate property registrations
A tax on long-term fixed deposits in commercial banks
e: STT yaani pratyaksh lena-den par lagne wala kar share bazaar mein kharide ya beche gaye pratyaksh koole ki keemat par lagta hai, isliye har souda chaahe labh ho ya nuksaan, kar banta hai. Doosra vikalp isi mulya ke hisaab se lagne wale kar ko sahi batata hai. Yah kar isliye pichhle soudon wale saudaon ke bharose nahi rehta, isliye satta tatha din mein kai baar khareed-farokht karne wale mehngi padti hai. Dallalon ka saalana licence shulk, zameen darj karane ka mohar shulk tatha jama rashi par milne wala beyaaj - ye teen bayaan is kar ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya kharchon tatha kamaiyon se jude hain. Exam point: share bazaar ke har lena-den ki keemat par lagne wala kar hi STT hai.

qe: What is the global tax challenge known as 'Base Erosion and Profit Shifting' (BEPS)?
qh: 'बेस इरोजन एंड प्रॉफिट शिफ्टिंग' (BEPS) से संबंधित वैश्विक कर चुनौती क्या है?
o: Tax planning strategies used by multinational enterprises that exploit gaps in tax rules to artificially shift profits to low-tax jurisdictions
The erosion of agricultural fertile soil due to mining runoff
The migration of domestic factory capital to coastal trading hubs
A sudden decline in national foreign exchange remittances
e: BEPS yaani buniyadi keemat ka kshay tatha munafe ka khisakna vah vishwa vyapari chunauti hai jismein badi kametiyan kar ke niyamon ke chhede khojkar apne munafe ko kam-kar wale deshon ki taraf jale raaston se khiska deti hain. Pehla vikalp isi chunauti ko sahi kholta hai. Yah samasya isliye khadi hoti hai ki ek hi kameti kai deshon mein kaam karti hai tatha har jagah ke niyam alag hain, isliye ve kam kar wale sthan chun leti hain. Kheti ki upjau mitti ka katna, karkhane ke punji ka samundari shehron ko jaana tatha videshi paise bhejne mein kami - ye teen bayaan is chunauti ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp bhugol ya anya vishle sahi nahi hain. Exam point: niyamon ke chhede khojkar munafe ko kam-kar deshon mein khisakna hi BEPS hai.

qe: What is 'Fiscal Drag' in macroeconomics?
qh: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में 'राजकोषीय ड्रैग' (Fiscal Drag) क्या है?
o: A situation where sovereign debt yields surge past economic growth
A persistent fall in the value of the domestic currency against the US Dollar
Progressive taxation and inflation dampening aggregate demand by taking higher shares of real income as taxes
The administrative delay in tabling the union budget in Parliament
e: Fiscal Drag yaani rajkoshi keech: bahut tez badhti hui aay ke saath bhaav tatha shulk logon ki asli kamai ka bada hissa khurak le jaate hain tatha khapat ki maang ko dabaa dete hain, isliye badhotri khud dheemi ho jaati hai. Teesra vikalp isi dabav ko sahi bayaan karta hai. Yah bhaari khichav isliye dikhta hai ki aay badhne par log oonche kar ke dayre mein chale jaate hain, isliye unki jeb mein kam paisa bachta hai tatha khareed kam ho jaati hai. Bond par beyaaj ka badhna, rupaye ka lagaatar girna tatha budget ka der se pesh hona - ye teen bayaan is keech ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya aarthik dabavon se jude hain. Exam point: kar tatha mehngai milkar maang ko daba den to badhotri khud dheemi ho jaati hai - yahi rajkoshi keech hai.

qe: What constitutes 'Deflation' in an economy?
qh: अर्थव्यवस्था में 'अपस्फीति' (Deflation) क्या होती है?
o: A sudden spike in the exchange rate value of domestic bank deposits
A slowdown in the speed at which inflation climbs
A persistent decline in the overall price level of goods and services (negative inflation)
A temporary shortage of bank lending capital
e: Deflation yaani gilayavat wo halat hai jismein saaman tatha sevaon ke aam keemat ke star mein lagatar kami hoti hai, isliye yah rinaatmak mehngai ke jaisa hota hai. Teesra vikalp isi lagatar girne ko sahi thehrata hai. Yah sthiti isliye khatarnak hoti hai ki log yah sochkar khareedna taalte hain ki kal aur sasta milega, isliye maang tatha utpadan dono sikud jaate hain tatha beroonzmari bane rehti hai. Bhandar ke vinaam moolya ka achanak chadhna, mehngai ki raftaar ka dheema hona tatha bankon ke karz ke paise ka achanak kam hona - ye teen bayaan gilayavat ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya halat bayaan karte hain. Exam point: aam keematon ka lagatar girna tatha rupaye ki taaqat ka badhna hi gilayavat hai.

qe: Which of the following is a direct adverse impact of persistent Rupee depreciation on the Indian economy?
qh: भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था पर रुपये के लगातार अवमूल्यन का सीधा प्रतिकूल प्रभाव निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा है?
o: Foreign travel becoming significantly cheaper for Indian citizens
Imported inflation caused by higher domestic currency costs for crude oil and raw materials
An automatic reduction in the rupee value of external foreign debt
A decrease in the profit margins of export-oriented IT service firms
e: Rupaye ke lagaatar girti keemat ka seedha bura asar aayatan wali mehngai hai kyunki kaali tatha kachche maal ko desi paise mein khareedne par zyada rupaye dene padte hain, isliye laagat tatha keemat dono chadh jaate hain. Doosra vikalp isi aayatan wali mehngai ko sahi dikhata hai. Yah asar isliye hota hai ki vishwa bazaar mein kaali tatha anya dhatuon ki keemat videshi currency mein tay hoti hai, isliye rupaye ki keemat girne par wahi saaman mehngi padti hai. Videshi yatra ka sasta hona, baahar ke karz ki rupaye wali keemat ka apne aap girna tatha niryat karna wali soochana kametiyon ke munafe ka girna - ye teen bayaan girne ke asar ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp galat ya ulta natija dikhate hain. Exam point: rupaya girne par kachcha maal mehnga padta hai - isi ko aayatan wali mehngai kehte hain.

qe: Why does the RBI avoid liquidating foreign exchange reserves to directly fund domestic infrastructure projects?
qh: आरबीआई आमतौर पर अपने विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार का उपयोग सीधे घरेलू बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजनाओं के वित्तपोषण के लिए क्यों नहीं करता है?
o: Because it is strictly forbidden under international civil maritime law
Because foreign exchange reserves carry a negative yield on the global market
Because the government has no authority to utilize foreign exchange
Converting billions of foreign currency reserves into domestic currency would flood the banking system with excess liquidity, igniting severe inflation
e: Videshi mudra bhandar ko seedhe sadak tatha bijli jaise kaamon ke kharch mein na lagaye jaane ka karan yah hai ki badi matra mein videshi currency ko desi paise mein badalne se bankon mein tairta hua paisa badh jaata hai, isliye bhaav ki aag bhadak sakti hai. Chautha vikalp isi khatre ko sahi batata hai. Aise istemal se bachne ka karan yah bhi hai ki yah bhandar videshi karz tatha aayatan ke bhugtan ke liye bima ki tarah rakha jaata hai, isliye ushe khatam karna khatarnak hota hai. Samundari kanoon ki poori rok, videshi bhandar par rinaatmak munafa tatha videshi mudra par sarkar ka koi haq na hona - ye teen bayaan is niyam ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp alag tatha galat wajah batate hain. Exam point: videshi bhandar ko seedhe kaamon mein badalna bankon mein tairta paisa badha kar mehngai bhadkata hai - yahi asli karan hai.
